text:

mention
音标：英 /'menʃn/  美 /'mɛnʃən/
n&v.  提及， 说起
短语：not to mention — 更不必说；不必提及
短语：mention of — 提及…
短语：make mention of — v. 提到，提及
短语：at the mention of — 在提到……时；一提起
短语：don't mention it — 不用介意
短语：special mention — 特别提名奖；（贷款等级）应加注意级
短语：honorable mention — n. 优秀奖；鼓励奖；荣誉奖
例句：Was my name mentioned at all?
我的名字被提到过吗？
例句：Some of the problems were mentioned in his report.
其中的一些问题在他的报告里提到了。
例句：(= it is important enough to mention ) that they only studied a very small number of cases.
必须说明的是他们仅研究了几个个案。
例句：As I mentioned earlier , there have been a lot of changes recently.
正如我刚才所说的，最近变化很大。
例句：She mentioned in passing (= mentioned in a quick unimportant way ) that you had just been to Rome.
她只是随口提了一下你刚刚去过罗马。
